message: Use the newly admitted WorldMirror interaction surface as a developmental sensorium. Study the smallest consequence-bearing abstraction that can turn repeated interaction traces into state-owned competence without collapsing raw storage into learning, self-dialogue into independent return, or action proposal into authorization. Prefer abstractions that later let the machine build richer interfaces and tools from high-level conversations while preserving O*, Anti-Minerva correction permeability, STOP/WITHHOLD, rollback, jurisdiction, and external evaluation.
purpose: Orient the next lawful autonomous study toward interaction-driven self-abstraction and progressively state-owned interface/problem/memory/action policy, while preserving epistemic nonsovereignty.
